opening.speaker: Narrator
opening.caption: Every night, Miso kept the world’s coldest computer company.
opening.title: 02:17 / THE MILLIKELVIN LAB

opening.speaker: Narrator
opening.caption: Doctor Lin called her an unauthorized lab assistant. Miso preferred supervisor.
opening.title: MISO / NIGHT SHIFT SUPERVISOR

opening.speaker: Narrator
opening.caption: One curious paw opened a return channel that should have stayed closed.
opening.title: INSERT / A VERY SMALL MISTAKE

opening.speaker: Narrator
opening.caption: The machine caught her pattern. The laboratory vanished around her.
opening.title: OVERHEAD / THE TRANSFER

opening.speaker: ADA
opening.caption: Miso? You can hear me. One cat, two possibilities. Stay with me.
opening.title: ADA / SIGNAL FOUND

opening.speaker: Null
opening.caption: Every memory in this machine belongs to me. Yours will be the last.
opening.title: NULL / THE UNINVITED GUEST

opening.speaker: ADA
opening.caption: Null is destroying us. Restore fifteen sectors and recover our three memories. I can bring you home.
opening.title: ADA / THE WAY HOME

opening.speaker: Narrator
opening.caption: For once, curiosity would have to save the cat.
opening.title: THE HEIST / STEAL BACK TOMORROW

ending.speaker: ADA
ending.caption: Isolation complete. Null has been erased. Miso, the way home is open.
ending.title: NULL / PURGE CONFIRMED

ending.speaker: Narrator
ending.caption: Across the last bridge of light, a familiar pattern returned to the laboratory.
ending.title: THE RETURN / ONE CAT

ending.speaker: Lin
ending.caption: Miso! You made it. Come here, you impossible little miracle.
ending.title: 02:18 / BACK IN THE REAL WORLD

ending.speaker: Lin
ending.caption: She saved every one of us! Our best researcher has four paws. Who is a good girl?
ending.title: THE LAB / OUR LITTLE HERO

ending.speaker: ADA
ending.caption: All fifteen sectors are clean. Thank you, Miso. You have earned that nap.
ending.title: ADA / EVERYONE ACCOUNTED FOR

ending.speaker: Narrator
ending.caption: Then, in a rack no one was watching, a disconnected monitor woke up.
ending.title: 02:19 / ONE UNNOTICED SIGNAL

ending.speaker: Unknown
ending.caption: Sleep well, little hero. Next time, I come through.
ending.title: UNKNOWN / NO SOURCE

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: Miso, your pattern is unstable. Hold both calibration plates so I can keep you here.
levels.clear: Two presences. One very real cat. I have your signal.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: Null has taken the observers. Restore the gallery switch and keep a branch on its plate.
levels.clear: The laboratory can see your signal again. Doctor Lin is waiting.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: The emergency power is behind these circuits. Flip the laser register, then open the phase shutter.
levels.clear: Power restored. Somewhere outside, a monitor lights up with your name.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: Your body cannot cross this membrane. Recover the receiver and send your state into the sealed chamber.
levels.clear: The transfer worked. We can build a path back to the laboratory.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: Our first memory is your identity. Recover the amber archive at the upper plate. Hold both cells to release it.
levels.clear: Identity recovered. Miso. Laboratory cat. Exceptionally poor respect for keyboards.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: Repair the power register. Without it, the memories cannot survive the journey home.
levels.clear: The memory bank is awake. Null can no longer erase what you have saved.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: These gates are scrambled. Cancel the two Hadamards, flip the bit, and restore our clock.
levels.clear: The clock is stable. But one timestamp is older than this computer.

levels.speaker: Null
levels.brief: You are repairing a door you do not understand. Turn back, little animal.
levels.clear: ADA: The watchdog is offline. Null is trying to frighten you. Keep going.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: This relay carries the return signal. Repair the shutter and transfer inside.
levels.clear: Doctor Lin can hear me. The laboratory is preparing to receive you.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: The second memory is the laboratory address. Recover the cyan archive inside cold storage.
levels.clear: Destination recovered. Home is no longer just a memory.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: Null is sweeping the echo archive. Restore its circuit and cross when the laser moves away.
levels.clear: There is a repeating mark in the old logs. No name. No matching process.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: Cut the firewall and repair the receiver. This relay will hold the route open while we reach the core.
levels.clear: Return route secured. The unfamiliar signal has gone silent.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: The final memory is our return key. Recover the violet archive beyond the moving firewall.
levels.clear: All three memories recovered. Identity, destination, permission to return.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: Null has retreated. Break both laser banks and open the last receiver shutter.
levels.clear: The core is exposed. Those strange marks are outside its infection signature. Later. First, get home.

levels.speaker: ADA
levels.brief: Repair the three circuits. Transfer inside, isolate the core at the upper switch, then purge it below.
levels.clear: Null is gone. Three memories safe. Return channel ready. Come home, Miso.
